open.thesis: Split out of the validator-drift thesis, which was closed today on its validator half. RUNBOOK.md KNOWN LIMITATIONS still reads 'seasonProj is assumed live, not proven ... if two snapshots days apart show identical numbers, it is a preseason artifact.' That is settled and settled the other way: chem-seasonproj-live-2026-09-21 proved the field recomputes after each slate by diffing two commits, 245 of 250 season projections changed. A run that follows the runbook literally here will under-trust a live field. The REAL limitation, observed again today, is different and narrower: seasonProj does not price AVAILABILITY. Wait and re-add Charbonnet free once activated: KEI returns added him at 02:58Z 1 Oct (20:58 Wednesday Mexico City), the day RotoWire reported he might practise Thursday and open his 21-day window. The thesis named a rival taking an OUT back as the only cost of waiting and called it unlikely; it happened, so the option it relied on is gone. No points lost yet (he cannot play before Week 5). The morning run missed the add and reviewed this as HELD.

Downs stays on the roster; closing the thesis is not a drop.
